question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the All India Services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Engineering Service**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **There are three All India Services in India.**

 
 
• the Indian Administrative Service (IAS),
 
• the Indian Forest Service (IFS) and
 
• the Indian Police Service (IPS) which are all Civil services of India.
 
 
 
• The officers can be allotted to any department, government or ministry.
 
• **Other services are allotted to particular ministries and can only be on deputation in other ministries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian Foreign Service** is the administrative diplomatic civil service under Group-A and Group B.
 
• It is not an All-India Service.
 
 
• The IFS is one of the Central Civil Services of the Executive branch of the Government of India.
 
 
 
• The common exceptional feature of All India Services is that the candidates selected for these civil services are recruited by the Center or the Union Government.
 
• The powers, purpose, and responsibilities of these All India Services are described in the All India Services Act, 1951.
